# 5280 Content

5280 Content LLC is a studio in Denver, Colorado. We build websites, apps, and tools for local businesses.

Email: hello@5280content.com
Website: https://www.5280content.com/

## What we offer

Local web design for businesses in Denver and Colorado. A website build is $500 one time. Hosting is $40 a month and continues until it is canceled. You can cancel anytime. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period. Hosting is managed in the Stripe customer portal. A free demo of the site is built before you pay.

- Local web design: https://www.5280content.com/web-design
- Website brief: https://www.5280content.com/web-design/brief

Products described on the site:

- Chairside: SMS booking and reminders for stylists and salons. In development.
- Excel-a-Route: scheduling and dispatch for route-based service businesses. In development.
- Chasing36: a public record of one golfer's pursuit of shooting 36. Live at https://chasing36.com
- TerritoryText: check outreach territories in and out from the web or by text. In development.
- Massive Empire Fantasy Football Tool: invite-only, live at https://massiveempire.win/
